These applications coming on for admission this day, th   passed the following:

ORDER These are the firs t bail applications filed on behalf of the applicants/accused under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail, as they are under apprehension of their arrest, in connection with Crime No.475/2023, registered at Police Station Semariya District Rewa (M.P.) for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 409, 120-B of the IPC and Section 3/7 of the Essential Commodities Act.
2. Considering the arguments and also taking into consideration the criminal records of applicants, I am of the view that it is not a fit case for grant of anticipatory bail.
Accordingly, both the applications are dismissed.

3. Cost of Rs.5,000/- is imposed upon counsel for applicant for arguing necessarily before the Court and wasting time, which shall be deposited with the M.P. High Court Legal Services Committee,
Jabalpur within two weeks.
